noticias.titular: Handing tasks to an AI agent means deciding first what it can see, remember and do
noticias.entradilla: Artificial intelligence assistants no longer just answer questions: they open folders, read email and act on behalf of the people who use them. Spain’s data protection authority has just published a ten-point guide to delegating without losing control. This report explains what changes, what companies and administrations say, and what a teacher can configure before granting an agent any permissions.
noticias.imagen_alt: Three overlapping circles, “Reads others’ content”, “Sensitive data” and “Acts alone”; in the overlaps of two, the safeguards “Read-only”, “No names” and “Ask for confirmation”, and in the centre, where all three meet, a red cross marked “Unacceptable risk”; at the bottom, a strip of five icons (eye, notebook, cursor, envelope and two people) for the AEPD’s five questions before delegating.

noticias.titular: An AI-made horror web series documents its workflow step by step
noticias.entradilla: “Never Sleep Again”, seven episodes released between 25 and 31 October, explains on its website how it combines Blender, Claude, a video generator and DaVinci Resolve.
noticias.imagen_alt: Horizontal diagram in five steps: “3D house”, a house modelled in 3D; “Reference”, a grey clip showing the camera path; “AI video”, the video generation; “Review”, with an arrow looping back; and “Editing”, a timeline; below, a human figure connected to every step.

noticias.titular: An interactive lab guides Year 13 students through gravitational potential
noticias.entradilla: The app “Mapa de potencial gravitatorio”, shared by teacher Antonio González, includes a nine-step teaching guide and calculates the work done between two points.
noticias.imagen_alt: On the left, equal-potential curves around a mass with two points, A and B, joined by two different paths; on the right, the same potential as a funnel seen from the side, with A and B at two heights and a red arrow labelled “Same work”: the work is the same along any path.

noticias.titular: An interactive activity teaches how to type the symbols on the Spanish keyboard
noticias.entradilla: The exercise, shared by Toni Magraner, trains symbols, accents and shortcuts with a test mode and a training mode.
noticias.imagen_alt: At the top, two rows of a keyboard with the 2 key and the AltGr key highlighted in blue; below, the combination AltGr plus 2, with a red equals sign, giving the @ symbol as the result.

noticias.titular: Syncing folders is not the same as backing up, a thread about Syncthing reminded members.
noticias.entradilla: Syncing folders is not the same as backing up, a thread about Syncthing reminded members. INCIBE recommends the 3-2-1 rule: three copies, on two different media, with one of them off-site.

noticias.titular: Eductia offers a paid AI tool for preparing teaching materials in Catalonia
noticias.entradilla: The service generates learning situations, activities and assessment instruments aligned with Catalan regulations, and raises the question of what it offers over a general-purpose AI.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram in three layers: at the top, “Teacher”, a person in front of a web window; in the middle, “Eductia”, the service's own layer with documents and chained steps; at the bottom, two model providers, “OpenAI” and “Anthropic”, connected by a dashed line ending in a red question mark, “Country?”, over the country where the data is processed.

noticias.titular: European Commission updates DigCompEdu to include AI and digital wellbeing
noticias.entradilla: The European framework for teachers' digital competence is under revision, with a final version expected in spring 2027 and consultations with teachers.
noticias.imagen_alt: Six circles around a centre, “Judgement”, teachers' professional judgement, surrounded by a dashed ring, “AI throughout”, AI present across the whole framework; on the right, “Wellbeing”, an axis with three icons: a clock, a screen and a power button.

noticias.titular: Teachers compare ways to keep the same skills and projects across several computers
noticias.entradilla: People who code with AI assistants on several machines describe three approaches: a Git repository, continuous synchronisation and a shared cloud folder.
noticias.imagen_alt: Two computers, each with a skills folder, joined by three paths: at the top, “Git”, a chain of dots representing a repository; in the middle, “Syncthing”, two back-and-forth arrows for continuous synchronisation; and at the bottom, “Cloud”, a shared folder.

noticias.titular: The group distinguished vibe coding, creating digital resources with AI and natural language, from agentic…
noticias.entradilla: The group distinguished vibe coding, creating digital resources with AI and natural language, from agentic AI, which pursues goals autonomously. It is an everyday explanation, not an official definition.

noticias.titular: EDUmind offers Galician and Spanish dictations with open-source synthetic voices
noticias.entradilla: A free web app created by Luis Vilela Acuña gathers dictations in Galician and Spanish for the final year of primary school, with openly licensed synthetic voices.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram of a dictation: a text on the classroom screen is turned into a synthetic voice, shown as a sound wave labelled “Galician” and “Spanish”, and into a printable rules sheet; below, three open-licence badges for texts, software and voice models.

noticias.titular: Google unveils Gemini 4 Carbon, for now only for cybersecurity specialists
noticias.entradilla: Google DeepMind has announced its new frontier model, which for now is used only by a small group of cyber-defence professionals. There is no date for the general public.
noticias.imagen_alt: A staircase of three steps rising from left to right: the first, with a few people, is cybersecurity defence; the second, with more people, is trusted partners; the third, dashed and with a half-open padlock, is marked “no date”.

noticias.titular: Plec generates foldable Catalan dictations, with audio, so that students can mark their own work
noticias.entradilla: An open app creates lists of words or pseudowords to dictate in class, printed on a folded sheet so that students can check their own answers.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram of three moments: “Dictated”, with a loudspeaker; “Written”, with a folded sheet on which students note their answers with the solution hidden; and “Marked”, with the sheet unfolded, the answers beside the solution and tick and cross marks.

noticias.titular: A prompt for creating interactive 3D lessons inspired by “Every Joule”
noticias.entradilla: A member of the groups shared a long prompt for an AI to generate an interactive 3D lesson in the style of a physics book about energy.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram of three steps: “Prompt”, a sheet with a dashed gap for the topic; “3D book”, an open book with a lifted flap revealing the answer; and “Stamp”, with a tick mark on completing the lesson.

noticias.titular: On 27 October the AEPD (Spain’s data protection authority) published a ten-point guide for people who use…
noticias.entradilla: On 27 October the AEPD (Spain’s data protection authority) published a ten-point guide for people who use AI assistants and agents. It recommends that the agent prepares and the person approves, with minimal permissions and confirmation before sending, sharing or paying.

noticias.titular: GitHub’s documentation states that teachers verified on GitHub Education can access Copilot Pro for free,…
noticias.entradilla: GitHub’s documentation states that teachers verified on GitHub Education can access Copilot Pro for free, and that eligibility is reassessed every month.
